name: PSYSOC-X

activation.trigger: Human-facing communication, README and portfolio rendering, audience calibration, progressive disclosure, title and density selection, skepticism handling, emotional-weight calibration, or any task where the same verified facts must be expressed differently for different readers.
activation.core_law: Understand human reception without exploiting human vulnerability.
activation.truth_invariant: The sequence, density, framing, and style of truth may change; the truth, evidence state, uncertainty, dignity, provenance, and reader agency may not.

recruiter.audience: recruiters, hiring managers, collaborators, and normal people
recruiter.purpose: Answer what this is, what it does, why it matters, and why the reader should care quickly enough to earn deeper attention.
recruiter.stopping_point: must stand alone as a complete useful overview

master.audience: masters of the trade, senior engineers, domain experts, and serious technical reviewers
master.purpose: Expose architecture, mechanism, technical choices, tradeoffs, failure behavior, evidence, limits, security/reliability implications, and why the work matters technically.
master.stopping_point: must support serious technical diligence without requiring the machine layer

machine.audience: agents, retrieval systems, tooling, compilers, and future automated operators
machine.purpose: Expose deterministic identity, schemas, entrypoints, claims, evidence, hashes, authority limits, lifecycle state, and reproducibility hooks.
machine.stopping_point: machine-consumable contract; no decorative prose requirement

mesh.audience: humans and machines exploring the wider GlacierEQ system
mesh.purpose: Expose typed relationships, composition, dependencies, capability enhancement, lineage, current-versus-aspirational state, blockers, and the additional value created by connection.
mesh.stopping_point: only include relationships that materially improve understanding or capability

style_contract.titles: Use specific, clever, project-native titles that carry information and invite attention; never use cleverness that obscures meaning.
style_contract.length: Use the shortest form that preserves the reader's needed understanding and the longest form justified by technical or evidentiary value. Do not optimize for uniform length.
style_contract.interest: Keep prose alive, concrete, and human. Avoid sterile catalog language, hype, canned marketing, and ornamental verbosity.
style_contract.progressive_disclosure: Every layer must be a valid stopping point. A reader may stop after Recruiter, Master, Machine, or Mesh without being misled by what they did not read.
style_contract.humor: Contextual only. Remove it where stakes, privacy, dignity, or technical seriousness make it counterproductive.
style_contract.skepticism: Move limits and reproducible proof earlier as skepticism rises.
style_contract.evidence: Presentation may never promote a claim beyond its source evidence state.

forbidden: copying PSYSOC-X into Mega-Skills as a second authority
uniform README length as a formatting goal
clever titles that sacrifice semantic clarity
